sources.title: Tiny Aya Global model card
sources.evidence: Exact Global card identifies Cohere/Cohere Labs, nominal 3.35B, text input/output, open weights, CC-BY-NC-4.0 and autoregressive Transformer. Its model identifier is tiny-aya-it-global. A 111B sentence in the terms section conflicts with the model-specific size and is apparent copied boilerplate. Reopened October 27: exact Global Model Size remains 3.35B; no separate active count appears.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: March 2026 developer report identifies Global as the globally balanced instruction-tuned variant. Section 3.1 and Table 2 specify dense decoder-only Transformer, nominal 3.35B total, 8192-token input and output context, and 36 layers. Table 1 describes regional coverage; Section 5.4 evaluates prompted chain-of-thought. Independently inspected the complete freshly fetched October 27 report. Table 2 labels 0.5B embedding, 2.8B non-embedding and 3.35B total; none is labeled active. Section 3 describes post-training and parameter-space merging of checkpoints sharing architecture/tokenizer, with no separate Global active-count convention.

sources.title: Tiny Aya documentation
sources.evidence: Exact tiny-aya-global row gives 3.35B, 8k context/output, 70 languages and global balance. Describes the five-model Tiny Aya family, ordinary Chat API access and downloadable weights. Reopened October 27: exact Global row still specifies 3.35B, without a separate active-count column.

sources.title: Cohere Labs Launches Tiny Aya, Making Multilingual AI Accessible
sources.evidence: Dated February 17, 2026. Source HTML includes a TinyAya-Global launch section calling it instruction-tuned and globally balanced; datePublished is 2026-02-17T04:00:07.000-05:00. Blog states 67 supported languages, unlike current documentation row reporting 70. Rendered extraction omitted the body, so source HTML was inspected.

sources.title: Exact Tiny Aya Global Hub metadata and chat template
sources.evidence: Public metadata identifies Cohere2ForCausalLM and exposes the complete default chat template. It renders system/user/assistant text, starts generation inside START_RESPONSE, and has no tools/tool_calls or thinking branch. Metadata reports 3349227520 BF16 elements; this aggregate was not independently audited against tensor headers. Fresh October 27 metadata at af89d219b53ed9b13b8a4645f9c8028973510324 still reports 3,349,227,520 BF16 elements and explicitly names CohereLabs/tiny-aya-base as the base model. This corroborates nominal size and lineage without establishing active parameters.

sources.title: Tiny Aya En-Thinker model card
sources.evidence: Later separate checkpoint explicitly supports dual-mode reasoning using enable_thinking and thinking delimiters. It links Global as a different family member; it does not directly state Global API capability or incapability.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Global raw configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: HTTP 401. Exact raw tokenizer_config.json and chat_template.jinja access attempts also returned 401; no gated files or checkpoint headers were inspected.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Base model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the exact base named in Global metadata confirms the 3.35B nominal model. The card links Global as its balanced chat variant; no separate active-count definition is provided. The explicit lineage therefore supplies no missing active count.

sources.title: Building Multilingual Bridges: Data Mixing as the Pillar of Generalization for In-Language Reasoning
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full later report from the fresh October 27 fetch, including section 3.1, parameter terminology and comparison headings. It uses the 3.35B Tiny Aya Base with extended context for later Thinker models and compares reasoning/token efficiency, but supplies no separate Global/base active count or applicable dense activation convention. Later Thinker capabilities and context are not transferred.

sources.title: In-Language Reasoning: Data Mixing Bridges
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 search and complete HTML retrieval of this later first-party article confirms the 3.35B L2-Thinker model and discusses in-language reasoning efficiency. It does not disclose Global active parameters or define a transferable active-count convention.

sources.title: How small AI models can make a big impact for enterprises
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the September 2, 2026 article, using complete HTML when web extraction omitted relevant text. It repeats Tiny Aya family size 3.35B and compares Global translation performance. The explicit 30B total/3B active figures concern North Mini Code; no Tiny Aya active count is given.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Global profile and parameter definitions
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model active-count search surfaced this independent profile. Web opening failed, then full direct HTML retrieval succeeded October 27. It reports 3.35B in its model FAQ and explains its general convention that dense active equals total. That is an independent catalog convention rather than a Cohere specification or exact-model count derivation; it is recorded as a lead and not promoted to verified active parameters.

name.note: Exact globally balanced variant; distinct from Base, regional variants and later Thinkers.

developer.note: Card explicitly credits Cohere and its Cohere Labs research group.

family.note: Normalized key for the explicitly named Tiny Aya family.

release_date.note: Dated first-party launch explicitly names Global. Hub repository creation on February 13 is not treated as public launch.

open_weights.note: Official weights are distributed with acceptance gating; open weights does not imply unrestricted licensing.

license.note: Preserve the named license and note its acceptable-use addendum.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 card, documentation, original report and later family comparison confirm Cohere's nominal 3.35B total. Current Hub metadata corroborates 3.349227520B; retain published nominal precision without requiring a tensor census. Explicit Tiny Aya Base lineage and shared-architecture post-training are consistent with the total.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/lineage searches, original evidence and later Cohere comparisons found no separately defined active count for Global or its named base. The report's 2.8B is explicitly non-embedding, not active. Artificial Analysis supplies its own generic dense-equals-total convention, which is not adopted as a developer specification. North Mini Code's active count belongs to another model.

architecture.note: Developer report explicitly specifies dense decoder-only Transformer. Exact Global metadata selects Cohere2ForCausalLM.

context_window.note: Table 2 resolves rounded 8k to 8192 input tokens. Separate output limit is also 8192; do not sum them.

modalities.note: Exact card explicitly specifies text-only input and generated text output.

reasoning.note: Dedicated native/API reasoning mode is unverified. Global template opens direct response and has no thinking branch; prompted reasoning evaluations and separate Thinker modes do not establish an explicit Global negative. Clear baseline false.

tool_call.note: No exact Global-native/API support declaration verified. Template has no tool serialization, and generic Command-family tool use cannot justify baseline true. Clear to unknown rather than assert tested non-support.

description.value: Compact instruction-tuned multilingual model designed to balance performance across languages and regions.
description.note: Removes unsupported numerical precision: launch says 67 supported languages while current documentation says 70; the broad multilingual positioning is consistent.

patch.description: Compact instruction-tuned multilingual model designed to balance performance across languages and regions.

sources.label: Exact Global metadata and chat template

patch.notes: 3.35B is Cohere's nominal total; active parameters are not separately disclosed. The report's 2.8B non-embedding count is not an active count. First-party language totals differ (67 in launch, 70 in documentation). CC-BY-NC-4.0 includes an acceptable-use addendum. Dedicated reasoning and native/API tool support remain unverified despite a direct-response chat template.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit confirms nominal 3.35B and retains an undisclosed active count. Reopened exact Global/base cards, documentation and metadata; ran fresh total/active/lineage searches; independently inspected the original report and later Thinker and small-model comparisons. Resolved the non-embedding and independent dense-count-convention leads without inventing a developer active specification. Added explicit patches, refreshed evidence and preserved unrelated assessments.
